حَصَادٌ The time, or season, of reaping; as also ↓ حِصَادٌ . (K, TA. [In the CK, each is erroneously made to be with ة.]) One says, [also, using each as an inf. n.,] هٰذَا زَمَنُ الحَصَادِ, (S, A,) or أَوَانُ الحَصَادِ, (Msb,) and ↓ الحِصَادِ , (S, Msb,) [This is the time, or season, of reaping: for] both are also inf. ns. of حَصَدَ in the first of the senses explained above. (Lh, K.) ＝
-A2- See also حَصِيدٌ. ―
-b2- Also What remains upon the ground, of seed-produce, among the lower parts of the stalks of that which has been reaped; and so حَصَائِدُ, pl. of ↓ حَصِيدٌ and ↓ حَصِيدَةٌ . (Mgh.) ―
-b3- And What falls off, and becomes scattered, of seeds of wild leguminous plants when they dry up. (L.) ―
-b4- And The fruit, or produce, of any tree. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
